OneDrive._comment: Application (client) ID of VaultGuard's Azure AD app registration used for personal Microsoft account sign-in (public client, no secret). Business/work accounts still register their own app via Settings.

Sso._comment: Sign in with Google - verifies the user's email so the login screen's profile picker can select the right account faster; it never touches the master password (see SsoConfiguration's doc comment). Empty by default: the 'Continue with Google' button is hidden until both values are set. Create a 'Desktop app' OAuth client at https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials (separate from any Web application client - no redirect URI needs to be registered).

Sentry._comment: Set Dsn to your Sentry project DSN to enable error reporting. Can also be set at runtime via Settings → About → Error Reporting.
